Recently, Fearnley proposed an example on which PI needs an exponential number of iterations to converge. Though, it has been observed that Fearnley's example leaves open the possibility that PI behaves well in many particular cases, such as in problems that involve a fixed discount factor, or that are restricted to deterministic actions.
